import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify, brute, controller
from fractions import Fraction
bad=0; n=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 300
for i in range(n):
    rng=random.Random(31337+i)
    S=rng.randint(1,3); F=rng.randint(2,3); J=rng.randint(2,7)
    t=rng.sample([0,3,7,13,29],S); t.sort()
    slots=[[t[k], rng.randint(1,2), 0 if k==0 else rng.randint(0,2)] for k in range(S)]
    B=rng.randint(1,3)
    flows=[]
    for f in range(F):
        tg=rng.randint(1,3); flows.append([tg, rng.randint(tg,5), -1, rng.randint(0,6)])
    G=rng.randint(0,2); groups=[[-1 if rng.random()<.5 else (0 if g>0 else -1), rng.randint(1,4)] for g in range(G)]
    for fl in flows:
        if G and rng.random()<.5: fl[2]=rng.randint(0,G-1)
    wins=[]
    for j in range(J):
        a=rng.randrange(S); b=rng.randrange(S)
        ready=t[min(a,b)]-1 if rng.random()<.5 else 0
        exp=t[max(a,b)]
        wins.append([rng.randrange(F), max(0,ready), exp, rng.randint(1,65535), rng.randint(1,320),
                     rng.choice([0,0,1,65535]), rng.choice([1,1000]),
                     [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    c={'model':rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),'class_values':[1000,1,1,1,1,1,1],'stats':[rng.randint(1,50),rng.randint(1,50),75],
       'bucket':[B,rng.randint(0,B)],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':wins}
    req={'version':3,'cases':[c]}
    try:
        resp=controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode())
        verify.check_request(req,resp)
        r=resp['results'][0]
        br=brute.best(c, r['predictions'])
        got=(Fraction(r['ratio'][0],r['ratio'][1]), r['utility'], r['age'])
        if got!=br:
            bad+=1; print('MISMATCH',i,got,br,json.dumps(c)[:400])
            if bad>3: break
    except Exception as e:
        bad+=1; print('FAIL',i,type(e).__name__,str(e)[:150])
        if bad>3: break
print('skew trials',n,'bad',bad)
PYEOF
